$comment: Third-party files copied into this site verbatim, and how to tell when a copy has fallen behind.
.github/workflows/vendor-check.yml reads this file every Monday. Changing a vendored file means
updating its hash here in the same commit, or that check fails on the next run.
See site/README.md, 'Analytics', for why count.js is vendored rather than loaded from a CDN.

$pin: count.v5.js is a frozen release: one commit upstream, 2025-06-09, untouched since.
So this copy cannot drift, and staleness is not the question to ask about it. What the
check watches instead is whether upstream's unpinned count.js has moved past what v5 does,
and whether a count.v6.js has appeared. v3, v4 and v5 are served today; v6 is not.
